cards.text: Abraham's son Isaac just married Rebekah (Genesis 24:67), and now the story circles back to Abraham. He had taken another wife, named Keturah, and she bore him six sons, Midian among them. From there the family tree branches into grandsons and whole clans, and friend, you know that family group chat that buzzes nonstop until your phone just gives up? THIS family.

cards.question: With all those sons around, Abraham leaves everything he owns to ___.

cards.text: While he's still alive, Abraham sends the sons of his concubines away from his son Isaac, off to the land of the east. Sent away? Oh, I KNOW that one, friend, because the Millers slid me into the back of a junk drawer and nobody even waved.

cards.question: Before they head east, what does Abraham give the sons of his concubines?

cards.text: Abraham lives a total of 175 years. Then at a ripe old age, he breathes his last and dies, and he's gathered to his people.

cards.question: Abraham breathes his last at a ripe old age. How is he when he goes?

cards.text: His sons Isaac and Ishmael bury him in the cave of Machpelah near Mamre. It's in the field Abraham had bought from the Hittites.

cards.question: Abraham is laid to rest in the cave of Machpelah. Who is buried there with him?
After Abraham's death, God ___ his son Isaac, who lived near Beer-lahai-roi.

cards.text: Now the spotlight swings over to Abraham's OTHER son, and Ishmael gets a whole account of his own.

cards.question: Ishmael is Abraham's son by ___ the Egyptian, Sarah's maidservant.

cards.text: Then comes the list of Ishmael's sons in birth order, starting with his firstborn, Nebaioth: twelve princes of their tribes, named by their villages and encampments. TWELVE, friend. I had SIX little cookie cutters on one kitchen counter, and I spent half my days catching them with my mustache before they wobbled off the edge.

Ishmael lives a total of 137 years, and then, like his father, he breathes his last, dies and is gathered to his people. His descendants settle from Havilah to Shur, which is near the border of Egypt.

cards.question: Ishmael's descendants live at peace with all their brothers.
